name: Rachel
source: Rachel does not like the stereotypical  appearance of vampires. This leads her to conflict with her family and other vampires. Rachel does not have many friends because she is considered unreliable. She doesn't keep her promises, always arrives late, and cannot be counted on. Rachel is very insecure and always finds it difficult to make even the easiest choices.
